name: AGC-026 -- UAC-Bypass Behavior (fodhelper)
description: Disclosure: Executed & documented by Claude Code under direction and review by Ali. | AGC-026: UAC bypass via fodhelper.exe ms-settings registry hijack. Sysmon EID 13 (T1042 RuleName) + EID 1. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Critical.

techniques.comment: AGC-026: UAC bypass via fodhelper.exe. Registry hijack of HKCU\Software\Classes\ms-settings\Shell\Open\command detected by Sysmon EID 13 (RuleName: T1042). fodhelper.exe launch at High integrity captured by EID 1.
